verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents a voice agent that 'listens, thinks, and answers out loud' and an SDK-owned tool-calling loop, and its rcli demo accepts spoken natural-language commands. A hands-on tester reported that 'navigate to google.com in safari' did nothing while the voice replied 'I navigated to google.com'. The vendor acknowledged that small models confuse knowing the intent with doing it, and other testers reported the CLI segfaulting or not working. Missing for 10: reliable execution of natural-language commands, first-party docs on operating the product itself (CLI/Wally) via natural language, and independent confirmation that commands actually execute.
